name: Roadmap
description: Phased roadmap deck: cover, phasing rationale, three phase cards, milestones & owners. Engine fills cover + totals; AI writes the phase scope narratives and the milestones section. **Hard constraint:** every section lands in a fixed-height slide text frame (≈4.0" × 7.5" for phase scope, ≈2.0" × 11.8" for milestones). The total budget per phase section is ~500 characters; milestones ≤ 700 characters. Going over makes PowerPoint auto-shrink to unreadable sizes.

sections.title: Phase 1 — Foundation scope
sections.purpose:
Describe the scope of Phase 1 (Foundation): the de-risking wave — prerequisites, high-risk dependencies, the most critical findings/risks the team must address before scaling work.

**Strict format:**
- Open with ONE sentence (≤ 25 words) summarising the wave's intent.
- Then a markdown bullet list of 3–5 workstreams, each ≤ 12 words.
- NO hours, costs, or dates — engine fills those on the same slide.

Total output ≤ 500 characters.

sections.title: Phase 2 — Build scope
sections.purpose:
Describe Phase 2 (Build): the throughput wave — net-new capability, integrations, hardening of the work seeded in Phase 1.

**Strict format:**
- ONE-sentence summary (≤ 25 words) referencing what Phase 1 closed off.
- Markdown bullet list of 3–5 workstreams, each ≤ 12 words.
- NO hours/cost/dates.

Total output ≤ 500 characters.

sections.title: Phase 3 — Scale scope
sections.purpose:
Describe Phase 3 (Scale): the optimisation wave — rollout, operational maturity, governance hand-off, retiring scaffolding.

**Strict format:**
- ONE-sentence summary (≤ 25 words).
- Markdown bullet list of 3–5 workstreams, each ≤ 12 words.
- NO hours/cost/dates.

Total output ≤ 500 characters.

sections.title: Recommended milestones
sections.purpose:
Synthesise the assessment's CRITICAL + HIGH recommendations into actual milestones — outcomes, not tasks.

**Strict format:**
- Up to 8 milestones as a markdown bullet list.
- Each bullet ≤ 15 words. Pattern: `Phase N · **Milestone name** — outcome.`
- Skip MEDIUM/LOW recs unless foundational.
- Do NOT paste the raw recommendations list — curate.

Total output ≤ 700 characters.
